import re

def parse_grid_after(text,label, dims):
    # section label line is e.g. "Demo pair 2 input (22x24):"
    m=re.search(re.escape(label)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',text)
    assert m,(label,text[:100])
    h,w=map(int,m.groups())
    rows=[]
    for ln in text[m.end():].splitlines():
        if not re.fullmatch(r'\s*\d+(?:\s+\d+)*\s*',ln): break
        vals=list(map(int,ln.split()))
        if len(vals)!=w: break
        rows.append(vals)
        if len(rows)==h: break
    assert len(rows)==h,(label,len(rows),h)
    return rows

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = grid[0][0]

    for r in range(h):
        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value != background]
        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = 3

    for c in range(w):
        marks = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != background]
        for top, bottom in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                out[r][c] = 3

    return out
'''
